entities.summary: Masjid Al-Huda is a mosque located along the Jalan Haji Alias road in Bukit Timah, Singapore. The mosque was completely rebuilt in 1966 from an older structure and is now located in the middle of a neighbourhood of landed terrace houses. It is one of two mosques situated in Bukit Timah, the other being Masjid Ba'alwie off Lewis Road.
